amount.description: Withdraw amount as a positive decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '0.5' for half a unit. At most 18 decimal places; a nonzero digit beyond the 18th is refused. Send the amount itself, not a count of smaller units: '1' withdraws one whole unit. The signed authorization carries amount_e18, this amount times 10^18, so '0.5' is signed as 5 times 10^17. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN, the amount has at most as many decimal places as the destination network token (AssetChainVariant.source_decimals); a finer amount is refused with AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ROUTE_PRECISION before any funds are reserved.

assetId.description: Unified asset identifier from Polyester asset metadata. amount is in whole units of this asset.

deadlineTsSec.description: Unix timestamp in seconds after which this signed user authorization is no longer accepted by the API. This is separate from the server-owned execution deadline used later for on-chain submission.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN this is an address on destination_chain_id and is validated according to that network. For TO_FUNDING, omit it to move funds to the selected account's Funding account or provide another Polyester funding address for a Trading-to-Funding transfer.

destinationChainId.description: Polyester chain id of the destination network for TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN: ChainConfig.chain_id from GetDepositWithdrawConfig, not the network's native chain id (ChainConfig.native_chain_id, such as 11155111 for Ethereum Sepolia). An unknown id is refused with ERROR_CODE_INVALID_DESTINATION_CHAIN. Omit for TO_FUNDING.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen idempotency key. Reusing the same key with the same payload returns the existing withdraw; reusing it with different payload fails.

nonce.description: Client-generated unsigned 128-bit nonce bound to the signed request. This is an identifier, not a decimal amount.

payloadSignature.description: User/API signature over deterministic TradingWithdrawIntentPayload bytes. Must not be empty.

intentId.description: Stable server-owned intent identifier for the accepted withdraw lifecycle. Clients use this id to follow later progress for the same withdraw flow.

deadlineTsSec.description: Unix timestamp in seconds after which the signed batch is no longer accepted, at most 15 minutes ahead.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen idempotency key for the whole batch, scoped to the source account. Retrying with the same key and the same signed batch returns the first answer; reusing it for another batch is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. The first answer stands, after the deadline too. A refused batch is final: a retry under its key answers the same refusal, even once its cause is gone, so a corrected batch needs a new key and signature.

legs.description: Moves to make, in order. 1 to 10 legs. Legs may repeat an asset or a destination.

destinationAddress.description: Funding address credited by this leg; omit it to credit the source account's own Funding account.

nonce.description: Client-generated unsigned 128-bit nonce bound to the signed batch. This is an identifier, not a decimal amount.

payloadSignature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign signature over the batch message described above.

balances.description: Every zToken the wallet holds a nonzero balance of, ordered by zipped_asset_id. Empty when it holds none. An asset whose balance could not be read is in unavailable_assets instead.

amount.description: Balance as a decimal string in whole units of the zToken, for example '0.5' for half a unit, with at most 18 decimal places.

chainId.description: External network of the zipped asset, the chainId of GetDepositWithdrawConfig.

unifiedAssetId.description: Unified asset the zToken stands for.

zippedAssetId.description: Zipped asset of the zToken: the network-specific asset, as chain.lifecycle.v1.AssetIds.zipped_asset_id names it.

ztokenAddress.description: zToken contract address on Polyester Chain.

smartAccountAddress.description: Smart account wallet whose balances these are.

unavailableAssets.description: Zipped assets whose zToken balance could not be read, ordered by zipped_asset_id. The wallet's balance of each is unknown, not zero: read again later. Empty when every balance was read. When no balance can be read at all, the request fails as unavailable instead.

chainId.description: External network of the zipped asset, the chainId of GetDepositWithdrawConfig.

reason.description: Why the balance could not be read: NO_CONTRACT, READ_FAILED or INVALID_BALANCE. The balance is unknown, not zero.

unifiedAssetId.description: Unified asset the zToken stands for.

zippedAssetId.description: Zipped asset of the zToken, as WalletBalance.zipped_asset_id names it.

ztokenAddress.description: zToken contract address on Polyester Chain listed for the zipped asset.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address to validate for destination_chain_id.

destinationChainId.description: Polyester chain id of the destination network: ChainConfig.chain_id from GetDepositWithdrawConfig, not the network's native chain id (ChainConfig.native_chain_id, such as 11155111 for Ethereum Sepolia). An unknown id answers valid false with UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN.

canonicalDestinationAddress.description: Canonical destination address when valid. Empty when valid is false.

message.description: User-safe explanation of the validation outcome.

valid.description: Whether the destination may be used for a withdraw.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BALANCE: The balance read returned a value that is not a valid balance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NO_CONTRACT: No zToken contract exists at the listed address on Polyester Chain.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_FAILED: Polyester Chain answered the balance read with an error.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DENYLISTED_ADDRESS: The destination is blocked by Polyester's user-safety denylist.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ADDRESS: The address is not valid for the selected destination chain.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLYESTER_SMART_ACCOUNT: The destination is a Polyester smart account and cannot be used for an external-chain withdraw.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TOKEN_CONTRACT: The destination is a token contract and cannot receive withdrawals.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN: The selected destination chain is not supported for withdraws.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VALID: The destination is valid and may be used for a withdraw.

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.
